title: East Asian Calendar & Solar Terms Open Data (2020-2035)
subtitle: Deterministic JSON and CSV datasets for 24 solar terms, lunar new moons, cross-timezone Lunar New Year dates, Japanese almanac, Korean Son-eomneun-nal, and Javanese Pasaran cycles.
description: Structured JSON and CSV datasets covering 24 solar terms (2020-2035, VSOP87D at exact minute precision in UTC, JST, and UTC+8), lunar new moons (2020-2035), cross-timezone Lunar New Year dates (China UTC+8, Vietnam UTC+7, Korea UTC+9), Japanese almanac indicators (2025-2030), Korean Son-eomneun-nal dates (2025-2030), and Javanese Pasaran/Weton cycles (2025-2030). Generated deterministically by Koyomi Days (https://koyomidays.com/en/open-data/).
